bad.title: Send never changes its look
bad.text: Sending, failed and empty all show the same ready button.

bad.title: Not sent, and nothing says so
bad.text: With Wi‑Fi off, the text stays in the box and Send looks ready, so people press again.
bad.wait: Turn Wi‑Fi off and press Send to see this.

good.title: Send shows each step
good.text: Sending… with a spinner, then Sent with a check, so people know to wait.

good.title: Retry, in the error color
good.text: With Wi‑Fi off, Send becomes Retry, so people know the message didn’t go.
good.wait: Turn Wi‑Fi off and press Send to see this.

good.title: Off when there’s nothing to send
good.text: An empty box can’t be sent, and the button looks it.
good.wait: Empty the message box to see this.

bad.title: Publish is off, and nothing says why
bad.text: Title and Story are filled in, so people reread them and guess.

bad.title: Topic reads None
bad.text: It’s the one thing missing, but it looks like a fine choice.

good.title: The reason sits next to the button
good.text: People go straight to Topic instead of rereading the whole post.

good.title: Topic is named as the fix
good.text: Pick Travel, and Publish turns on while the hint goes away.

bad.title: No ring on any reply
bad.text: After two Tabs, Accept, Maybe and Decline look the same, so Enter is a guess.

bad.title: The answer shows only after Enter
bad.text: People learn which reply they picked once it’s already sent.

good.title: A ring shows where Tab landed
good.text: People see which reply is focused before they press Enter.

good.title: The reply matches the ring
good.text: Your reply names the button the ring was on, with no surprise.

good.title: No ring on mouse clicks
good.text: Clicking Accept shows only its pressed look, so the ring never gets in the way.

bad.title: Still takes clicks while it loads
bad.text: A nervous double-click places two orders and charges $202.

bad.title: Edit cart gets pushed aside
bad.text: The label grows to “Placing your order…” and shoves the button next to it.

bad.title: Two orders from one purchase
bad.text: After a double-click it reads 2, with 1 by accident.

good.title: Repeat clicks do nothing
good.text: Once pressed, it shows Placing… with a spinner and ignores the rest.

good.title: Edit cart stays put
good.text: Place order keeps its width, so nothing beside it moves.

good.title: One order, however many clicks
good.text: The count stops at 1.

bad.title: “No items” says nothing
bad.text: Not that albums go here, or how to make one.

bad.title: The only way in is a small +
bad.text: It sits in the corner of the bar, with no label to find it by.

good.title: Names what belongs here
good.text: Albums you create will show up here, so the empty screen makes sense.

good.title: The first album, one press away
good.text: New album sits in the middle of the empty space, where people are looking.

good.title: The + is still there for later
good.text: Once albums exist, it’s the way to add more.

bad.title: Five buttons, all the same weight
bad.text: None is marked as the start, so a new person stops to compare them.

bad.title: Import leads to another task
bad.text: It asks to connect Google Drive or Dropbox first, a detour for someone new.

good.title: One clear place to start
good.text: A single primary button, so a new person knows where to press.

good.title: Templates, quieter, below it
good.text: There for people who look for them, without competing for the first press.

bad.title: Search says “No items”
bad.text: Nothing points at the filter that emptied the results.

bad.title: Size 9 is the cause, unnamed
bad.text: The filter sits right above, but the message never links the two.

bad.title: Wishlist says the same words
bad.text: A new list and a too-narrow search look identical.

good.title: Names the search and the size
good.text: People can tell the filter is the problem, not the shop.

good.title: The fix is one press
good.text: Clear size filter brings back 3 sneakers.

good.title: Wishlist explains how to start
good.text: Press Save on anything, and Browse sneakers leads back to search.

bad.title: The real problem, unmarked
bad.text: End is 9:00, before Start at 10:00, and nothing points at it.

bad.title: The same words for every cause
bad.text: A wrong time, no Wi‑Fi and a server problem all read the same.
bad.wait: Press Save event to see this.

good.title: End is marked as the problem
good.text: The field people need to change is flagged where they look.
good.wait: Press Save event to see this.

good.title: It names both times and the fix
good.text: It says to change one of them. No Wi‑Fi and a server problem get their own words.
good.wait: Press Save event to see this.

bad.title: OK is the only way out
bad.text: It closes the message and leaves an empty screen, with the photos still missing.

good.title: Try again leads
good.text: Most dropped connections recover, and the 6 photos load on the second try.

good.title: Get help for when it keeps failing
good.text: It suggests checking other sites, then turning Wi‑Fi off and on.

bad.title: The selection is wiped
bad.text: It reads No photos selected, so all 40 must be picked again.

bad.title: Progress back to 0 of 40
bad.text: The 18 that went through get sent a second time.
bad.wait: Press Upload 40 photos and wait for it to stop.

good.title: Still 40 selected, 18 uploaded
good.text: Nothing to pick again, and the count says how far it got.
good.wait: Press Upload 40 photos and wait for it to stop.

good.text: Only the 22 left get sent, so nothing goes up twice.

bad.title: Error 500, and nothing else
bad.text: People can’t tell if it’s their fault, or whether to wait.

bad.title: Try again, with no reason to
bad.text: Without a word on the cause, people don’t know if retrying will help.

good.title: It says what didn’t load
good.text: Your playlists, named in plain words, before anything technical.

good.title: Whose problem, and what to do
good.text: Not yours, and a minute’s wait should fix it.

good.title: The code, small and last
good.text: Code 500 and the ref are there for support, out of the way.
